_rationale: minAmount=0 floor permits cash to drain to zero. Year 0: cash 100k - 50k spending = 50k. Year 1: 50k - 50k = 0. Year 2: cash empty, spending falls through to Taxable (100k - 50k = 50k). Year 3 (last, lifeExpectancy=63): Taxable 50k must cover 50k spending PLUS the LTCG tax on the pull - it falls short, so the final year is a deterministic shortfall and probability is exactly 0 (0% stddev makes all runs identical; one failed year fails the run).
